cohort: Twenty normal, first-time singleton pregnancies were scanned 7 times between the 14th and 38th week of gestation.
finding: The mean placental volume increases linearly from the 14th to the 38th week of gestation with a constant mean growth rate of 29.97 ml/week, and there is a good correlation between placental size and birth weight.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured at delivery and showed a good correlation with placental size (R = 0.56, p = 0.009).
gest_age: Participants were scanned between the 14th and 38th week of gestation, and all pregnancies were carried to term.
